en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small stream bordered by grassy banks and leafless or early‑spring trees. In the middle distance there is a low masonry bridge with railings crossing the stream, with village buildings and farm structures behind it. In the foreground several children in early 20th‑century clothing stand and play along the banks of the stream. The caption text is printed at the top in red.
